lead.description: the prediction of a qualitative response from features, by assigning each case to a class

overview_sentence: In [classification](articles/classification.qmd), features are used to predict a class label.

self_checks.title: Bayes error with three classes
self_checks.prompt: Class probabilities are 7/10, 1/5 and 1/10. What is the conditional error of the Bayes classifier?

self_checks.title: A worse label
self_checks.prompt: At those same probabilities, what is the conditional error of announcing the class whose probability is 1/5?

self_checks.title: Two-class overlap
self_checks.prompt: Two class probabilities are 11/20 and 9/20. What is the Bayes error?
